name: Monday.com
one_liner: Work management platform (boards, items, columns) with GraphQL API for apps and AI agents.
auth_notes: Personal API token for admins/members; OAuth2 for apps with scopes (new OAuth 2.1 flow with refresh tokens available).
access_notes: API is a free feature across all plans (daily call limit 200 on Free); viewers, guests (no key), student accounts cannot get tokens. Free developer account available for testing.

buildability.rationale: Free-plan API access with self-serve token and OAuth; documented rate limits and versioning; official hosted MCP. Free daily limit is low.

auth.quote: Admins and members have access to their own API tokens.
OAuth 2.0 is a protocol that lets your app request authorization to read or modify data in a user's monday account.

access.quote: maintains the API service as a free feature across all plans

sandbox.quote: For building and testing apps or API integrations without touching production data, use a free developer account.

api_surface.quote: You can use it to subscribe to events on your boards and get notified by an HTTP or HTTPS post request
We guarantee at least three different versions of the API in parallel and release a new version every quarter.

mcp.quote: The Platform MCP is monday.com's hosted MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, maintained by the monday.com AI team.

identity.quote: The monday GraphQL API is part of the monday apps framework.

disputes.why: Docs say API is a free feature across all plans.
Docs recommend free developer account for testing.
